title: 第九章 和小智的1v1第十章 和芽衣尴尬的相见 T
content_zh:
大木博士离开了，离开前一再的叮嘱林萧要以增强实力为主，不要做事三心二意到头来竹篮打水一场空，留下一颗大师球便坐着自己的私人直升机回真新镇了。
大木博士的话让林萧满头黑线，自己做事什么时候三心二意了？至于留下的大师球也是迫不得已，班吉拉的精灵球很快裂开了。就连在商店购买的高级球也一样，只不过坚持的时间久一点，无奈之下大木博士只好给林萧留下一个大师球，用来装班吉拉。
班吉拉真不是哥省心的货色，刚出来就让林萧赔了100万，精灵球就不说了，除了大师球，其他的精灵球都承受不住，这让林萧很无语，从来没有遇到过这样的事，就连听都没有听过。
吃饭的时候还会耍脾气，对各种神奇宝贝食物不屑一顾，别说吃，闻都不闻一下，直接将食物一脚踢飞脑袋扭朝一边，仿佛盆子里装的不是食物而是一坨便便。这样的情况搞得林萧丈二和尚摸不到头脑，大木博士也是一头雾水，两人围着班吉拉不停的忙乎，可不管换上什么口味的食物都是一样。
最终，饥饿难忍的班吉拉在林萧和大木博士目瞪口呆的模样下一把抢过乔伊的午餐盘，在乔伊的惊叫声中把食物倒入自己嘴里大口吞咽，吃完后还上下打量乔伊，看看乔伊身上还有没有食物。
班吉拉突如其来的举动没把乔伊吓个半死，就连神奇宝贝中心的其他人也吓得够呛，以为班吉拉要攻击乔伊。还好班吉拉只要抢她的午餐，并没有攻击她。
“这尼玛！啥情况？原来这货不吃神奇宝贝食物，和人一样的品味！！”满头黑线的林萧急忙收起班吉拉，尴尬的和乔伊道歉。
“呼，虽然吓我一跳，不过姐姐我就大慈大悲的原谅你好了，但是你的班吉拉很有个性，喜欢人类的食物，希望你好好照顾它。”乔伊拍着胸脯笑着说道。
虽然受到了惊吓，不过尼比市乔伊并没有放在心上，干这行经常都会碰到一些凶恶、脾气暴躁的小精灵，受到惊吓已经是常事了，有时候还会导致误伤。
乔伊不追究林萧松了一口气，送走了大木博士采购一番准备出发前往华蓝市。
一路上林萧还是照旧对野生的神奇宝贝进行扫荡，虽然系统跟新了，但是金币还是要赚。
跟新后的系统已经是大变样，前面的还能购买最终形态的小精灵比如快龙、班吉拉、喷火龙。现在门都没有，只能购买幼生期的进行培育，而且价格翻倍了，本来3000金币的迷你龙、由基拉现在要6000金币。
林萧有些庆幸，也有点失落，还好自己第一只购买的是班吉拉不是由基拉，恐怕是系统为了让自己的实力猛然突进设的坎了，不知道自己第二次购买以后还会不会涨价，如果这样的话只能挑精英。
能得到班吉拉林萧已经很高兴了，班吉拉的实力超乎想象，就连大木博士的快龙也要对它避让三分。虽然在自己的制止下没有打起来，但光凭气势就能看出很多东西。
来到月见山林萧选择就地扎营，此时太阳已经偏西，再不过久黑暗将会降临，在这个世界赶夜路可不是明智的选择。
搭帐篷，生活做饭这种对林萧来说很简单，只是做饭的分量要大一些，班吉拉的胃口很大，每一顿都吃的多，林萧的习惯一直都是把小精灵喂好以后自己才开动。
三菜一汤，林萧的晚饭。早一般人眼里很奢侈，特别是旅行的人。
谁让林萧是个叼嘴猫呢，用他的话来说什么都可以省，吃的绝对不行。
刚扒了两口饭，三个狼狈的身影出现在不远处。
三人的出现让林萧一愣，“这不是小智三人组吗？他们也到这里了？”

同样的三人看也看到了林萧，小智高兴的跑过来喊道：“太好了，居然在这里碰到林萧哥，看来今天晚上我们有口福咯！”
额。。。。。。林萧有些哭笑不得的看着小智，笑骂道：“就你小子鬼脑筋多，既然遇到了就一起吃晚饭吧。让你的同伴也一起好了，我再炒两个菜，马上就好。”
小智毫不客气的就地而坐，对着不远处得两人喊道：“小霞，小刚你们也一起来吧，林萧哥很和善的。”
“这样真的行吗？”小霞是女孩子遇到陌生人比较害羞，有些不安的朝小智悄声问道。
小刚则很尴尬，比较两人在尼比道馆的时候弄得很不愉快。
“没事，没事！你们尽管放心，林萧哥对人很好的。”小智大咧咧的对两人甩甩手，示意他们安心。
林萧微微一笑，对二人道：“你们就放宽心坐下吧，马上就能开动了，我为人比较开朗，你们随意就好。”
听了林萧的话，加上饭菜诱人的香味，小霞和小刚不再扭捏，和小智坐在一块。
很快林萧就炒了两个菜出来，五菜一汤差不多够吃了。
“我要开动咯！”
content_en:
Dr. Omu left. Before leaving, he repeatedly told Lin Xiao to focus on strengthening his strength and not to do things half-heartedly. In the end, everything was in vain. He left a master ball and returned to Zhenxin Town in his private helicopter.
Dr. Oki's words made Lin Xiao think twice. When did he become half-hearted in doing things? As for the Master Ball left behind, he had no choice but to do so. Bangira's Poké Ball soon cracked. Even the high-end balls bought in the store are the same, but they last longer. In desperation, Dr. Ohki had to leave a master ball for Lin Xiao to hold Bangira.
Bangila is really not someone to worry about. When he came out, he made Lin Xiao pay 1 million, let alone the Poke Ball. Except for the Master Ball, other Poke Balls couldn't bear it. This made Lin Xiao speechless. He had never encountered such a thing before, and he had never even heard of it.
He would also show his temper when eating, and would show disdain for all kinds of Pokémon food. Not to mention eating, he would not even smell it, but would kick the food away and turn his head to the side, as if the basin contained not food but a pile of poop. This situation made Monk Lin Xiaozhang confused, and Dr. Omu was also confused. The two of them were busy around Bangila, but it was the same no matter what flavor of food they put on it.
In the end, Bangila, who was unbearably hungry, grabbed Joey's lunch plate while Lin Xiao and Dr. Omu looked stunned. He poured the food into his mouth and swallowed it while Joey screamed. After eating, he looked at Joey up and down to see if there was any food on Joey.
Bandera's sudden move didn't scare Joey half to death. Even other people in the Pokémon Center were frightened enough, thinking that Bandera was going to attack Joey. Fortunately, Bangila only wanted to grab her lunch and did not attack her.
"What the hell! What's going on? It turns out that this guy doesn't eat Pokémon food and has the same taste as humans!!" Lin Xiao, who had black lines on his head, hurriedly put away Bandera and apologized to Joey in embarrassment.
"Phew, even though it scared me, sister, I will forgive you mercifully, but your Benjira has a lot of personality and likes human food. I hope you take good care of it." Joey patted his chest and said with a smile.
Although he was frightened, Nibi City Joey didn't take it to heart. In this business, he often encountered some vicious and bad-tempered elves. It was common to be frightened, and sometimes it would lead to accidental injuries.
Lin Xiao breathed a sigh of relief when Joey did not pursue the case, and sent Dr. Oak away to do some shopping and prepare to leave for Hualan City.
Along the way, Lin Xiao still carried out raids on wild Pokémon. Although the system was updated, gold coins still had to be earned.
It’s a big change from the new system. In the previous one, you could also purchase the final forms of elves such as Kuailong, Bangira, and Charizard. Now there is no way, so you can only buy the young ones for cultivation, and the price has doubled. The mini dragon and Yukila that originally cost 3,000 gold coins now cost 6,000 gold coins.
Lin Xiao was a little lucky, but also a little disappointed. Fortunately, the first one he bought was Bangila and not Yujila. I'm afraid the system set a hurdle for him to suddenly advance in strength. He didn't know if the price would increase after his second purchase. If so, he could only choose the elite.
Lin Xiao is already very happy to get Bandila. Bandila's strength is beyond imagination. Even Dr. Oak's Kuailong has to avoid it. Although there was no fight under his own control, a lot of things could be seen from the momentum alone.
When Lin Xiao arrived at Yuejian Mountain, he chose to camp on the spot. At this time, the sun was already in the west, and darkness would fall soon. Traveling at night in this world was not a wise choice.
Setting up a tent, living and cooking are very simple for Lin Xiao, but the portions are larger. Bangila has a big appetite and eats a lot at every meal. Lin Xiao's habit has always been to feed the elf before he starts.Three dishes and one soup, Lin Xiao's dinner. It is very luxurious in the eyes of most people, especially those who travel.
Who told Lin Xiao to be a biting cat? In his words, he could save on everything except food.
Just after taking two bites of rice, three embarrassed figures appeared not far away.
The appearance of the three people made Lin Xiao startled, "Isn't this Xiaozhi's trio? Are they here too?"
The same three people also saw Lin Xiao. Xiaozhi ran over happily and shouted: "Great, we unexpectedly met Brother Lin Xiao here. It seems we are in good luck tonight!"
Um. . . . . . Lin Xiao looked at Xiaozhi dumbfounded, and scolded with a smile: "You are the only one with a lot of cleverness. Now that we have met, let's have dinner together. Let your companions cook together, and I will cook two more dishes, and they will be ready soon."
Xiaozhi sat down on the spot unceremoniously and shouted to the two people not far away: "Xiaoxia, Xiaogang, you can come too, Brother Lin Xiao is very kind."
"Is this really okay?" Xiaoxia, a girl who is shy when meeting strangers, quietly asked Xiaozhi uneasily.
Xiaogang was very embarrassed, and the two of them made it very unpleasant when they were in Nibi Gym.
"It's okay, it's okay! Don't worry, Brother Lin Xiao is very good to people." Xiaozhi waved his hands to the two of them carelessly, signaling them to feel at ease.
Lin Xiao smiled slightly and said to the two of them: "Just relax and sit down. We will start moving soon. I am a cheerful person, so you can do whatever you want."
After listening to Lin Xiao's words and the tempting aroma of the food, Xiaoxia and Xiaogang stopped being coy and sat together with Xiaozhi.
Soon Lin Xiao fried two vegetables and brought them out. Five vegetables and one soup were almost enough to eat.
"I'm going to start!"
